free_tier.stated: No free tier. The offer list is "Basic 8 [EUR] / mois", "Custom X [EUR] / mois" and "BYOIP 11 [EUR] / mois"; the page prints the euro sign, rendered here as EUR.

egress.terms: No transfer allowance is stated anywhere on the page. The plan lists a port rate instead: "10 Gbps" on every tier.; ingress: tcp+udp

interface_detail: Tunnels are created and deleted in the panel; no API named on the pages read.
tooling: wg-quick; panel provisioning for GRE, VXLAN, EOIP, WireGuard, IPIP
chaining: One IPv4 plus a /56 on a single tunnel covers a small fleet; the /56 removes the port-remap question for IPv6 clients.

limits.value: 10 Gbps port per tunnel, no byte allowance published

binding_note: At 1 TiB/month, 3.24 Mbit/s sustained, a 10 Gbps port is not the constraint and no byte quota is published. What would bind at larger scale is the one-tunnel, one-IPv4 shape of the Basic plan, which is an allocation limit rather than a volume one.

identity_cost.detail: Orders are placed in the Netaris panel (panel.netaris.fr), which implies a paid account; the registration form was not read.

reliability_note: Anti-DDoS is an option on the Custom tier only; nothing is stated about attacks on the Basic tier.
confidence_note: Price, allocation and tunnel types are first-party. The volume policy is absent, so a support answer would raise the volume field from unstated to documented.

evidence.proved: Basic 8 EUR/mo with 1 IPv4, 1 /56 IPv6, 1 tunnel, 1 subnet, 10 Gbps and a BGP session; WireGuard among the six tunnel technologies; no traffic figure
the documentation site is a stub: "Documentation en cours d'ecriture", so the panel workflow could not be checked

price_per_tb_month: EUR 8 per month for Basic (1 IPv4, 1 /56 IPv6, 1 tunnel, 10 Gbps)
notes: The only provider that prices a BGP session into the base plan, which matters if the client ever wants to announce its own space. The bridge option is 1 EUR extra. Custom and BYOIP tiers exist and are priced by quote.

extras.wg_detail: WireGuard is one of six tunnel types the client creates in the panel: "GRE, VXLAN, EOIP, WireGuard, IPIP, BGP", and "vous pouvez le creer avec n'importe quel type et le supprimer comme vous le souhaitez sur votre panel". The Basic plan carries "1 IPv4" and "1 /56 IPv6" routed to the tunnel.
extras.volume_stated: No transfer allowance is stated anywhere on the page. The plan lists a port rate instead: "10 Gbps" on every tier.
extras.transit_note: The vendor runs the tunnels on its own network, "interconnecte avec les plus gros operateurs Francais".
